cause: Advertised input caps were broader than the CPU importer. Restricting them to ordinary system memory also broke NVIDIA and Intel decoders whose allocators implement CPU reads.
ordinary_video: Unmarked input keeps its ordinary caps, format and memory domain.

input_contract.SystemMemory: All11 actual importer formats from canonical private table

output_contract: Always newly allocated SystemMemory RGBA64_LE/full BT.2020 PQ; both forward transform and final set_caps enforce this. Reverse exposes three explicit input-domain alternatives.

cuda.ordinary_READ: Without GST_MAP_CUDA, downloads/synchronizes into host staging and returns staging pointer.

va.ordinary_READ: Without GST_MAP_VA, ensures derived/downloaded VAImage and returns host va_map_buffer storage.

release.normal_source_replay: All product files and Debian packaging compared byte-for-byte against the public commit after extracting the built DSC.

controls: forward/reverse marked queries exclude unsupported input and impossible output
real appsrc pipeline rejects marked unsupported inputs at link or not-negotiated, while matching unmarked pipelines reach EOS
NV12 and P010 map from the CUDA and VA domains to graded system memory. Reverse negotiation names each supported input domain.

gpu.method: ISO BMFF through qtdemux and h265parse. The first run let decodebin select the decoder. The second selected vah265dec explicitly. A fakesink consumed the graded output. The mapper received the previously recorded 616 cd/m2 target and the original release provider. Both fixtures reached the bounded end on each GPU. Counts describe mapper log records, including preroll.
gpu.cpu_only_regression: With the first negotiation fix the real NVIDIA stream stopped with GST_FLOW_NOT_NEGOTIATED before the first mapped frame. The previous package played the identical stream.

scope: Digital render and negotiation only. No real desktop window, system install or panel measurement.
